criteria.reason: In src/index.js, addVisibilityAttribute is registered on 'blocks.registerBlockType' under the 'block-visibility-rules/add-attribute' namespace and skips core/freeform and blocks failing hasBlockSupport(settings,'customClassName',true), but the attribute is only `{ type: 'object' }`, with no default as the rubric requires.
In src/index.js, withVisibilityControls is built with createHigherOrderComponent, renders `<BlockEdit { ...props } />` and puts VisibilityPanel inside InspectorControls.
In src/index.js, VisibilityPanel renders a RadioControl for the type, and the two DateTimePicker controls only render when `type === 'date-range'`.
In src/index.js, withVisibilityClass adds 'has-visibility-rule' to the className prop it passes to BlockListBlock when the rule is restricted, and it is registered on 'editor.BlockListBlock'.
src/editor.scss defines the dashed outline and is imported in index.js, and block-visibility-rules.php enqueues the built build/index.css on enqueue_block_editor_assets.
In src/index.js, onChange calls doAction('blockVisibilityRules.ruleChanged', newRule, rule, clientId, name) after setAttributes.
In src/index.js, getRuleTypes returns applyFilters('blockVisibilityRules.ruleTypes', defaults), which becomes the RadioControl options.
In block-visibility-rules.php, register_attribute is hooked to register_block_type_args and adds a visibilityRule object schema with type/start/end properties to every supported block.
In block-visibility-rules.php, filter_render_block on render_block returns '' when rule_matches() is false and otherwise returns $block_content unchanged.
In block-visibility-rules.php, rule_matches uses is_user_logged_in() and compares current_datetime() against DateTimeImmutable values built with wp_timezone() in parse_date.
In block-visibility-rules.php, rule_matches returns apply_filters('block_visibility_rules_match', $matches, $rule, $block), so the result can be overridden (here $rule comes before $block).
In block-visibility-rules.php, enqueue_editor_assets includes build/index.asset.php and passes $asset['dependencies'] and $asset['version'] to wp_enqueue_script.
Every API used exists, including wp_is_serving_rest_request (guarded with function_exists), DateTimePicker is12Hour, Notice isDismissible and the hasBlockSupport default argument.
